metadata.title: General engineering-knowledge synthesis: feedback deregulation and competing-branch attenuation for L-lysine overproduction in Escherichia coli
metadata.reference_note: 此 DDR 是已确立的大肠杆菌天冬氨酸途径工程原则(反馈抗性 lysC、竞争支减弱)的综合摘要,非单篇论文的实验结果。无作者/期刊/DOI 是有意为之,不用编造的引用。

trigger.observation: 野生型 lysC(aspartokinase III)活性被 L-lysine 变构抑制——一旦胞内赖氨酸浓度上升,天冬氨酸途径的入口就被封堵。这是天冬氨酸途径的第一道调控门。
trigger.reasoning: 与色氨酸的 TrpE 反馈抑制同构:committed 酶被末端产物反馈抑制。解除方法是引入反馈抗性突变体(lysC-fbr),使 AKIII 对赖氨酸不敏感。
trigger.source_location: EcoCyc / 教科书级天冬氨酸途径调控知识

evidence.description: LysC 受 L-lysine 反馈抑制是已被充分验证的机制。晶体结构和酶动力学均证实赖氨酸与 LysC 调节域结合、变构抑制催化活性。
evidence.source_location: EcoCyc: LYSC-MONOMER; BRENDA: lysC inhibition kinetics; PDB: lysC regulatory domain structure

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 已知的、被结构和酶动力学多重验证的反馈抑制机制,归硬。

alternatives.rejected_reason: 不解除反馈抑制,过表达的酶仍被赖氨酸抑制——等于是增加被锁住的酶的拷贝数

alternatives.approach: 只用 lysC 的同工酶 lysA/metoK 等绕过
alternatives.rejected_reason: 天冬氨酸激酶有三个同工酶(lysC/thrA/metoK),但各自受不同产物反馈——只换同工酶不能解决赖氨酸特异性反馈

decision_chain.implementation_detail: 引入 lysC-fbr(feedback-resistant)等位基因——在赖氨酸结合域引入点突变,保留催化活性但消除赖氨酸介导的变构抑制

result.before: 胞内赖氨酸升高 → LysC 被抑制 → 途径入口关闭
result.after: lysC-fbr 不受赖氨酸抑制 → 途径入口保持开放,通量上限提升

decision_chain.rule: 天冬氨酸家族氨基酸(赖氨酸/苏氨酸/甲硫氨酸)的共通第一步:检查 aspartokinase 同工酶的反馈抑制状态。选对同工酶:lysC→赖氨酸途径,thrA→苏氨酸途径,metL→甲硫氨酸途径。引入反馈抗性突变体(fbr)是性价比最高的第一步干预。

trigger.observation: aspartate-semialdehyde 是共享分支点前体:一条路走 DAP 分支(→赖氨酸),另一条路走 homoserine 分支(→苏氨酸/甲硫氨酸)。即使 lysC 反馈抗性解除了入口限制,hom+thrB 仍然消耗 aspartate-semialdehyde,与赖氨酸分支竞争。
trigger.reasoning: 解决了入口瓶颈后的下一步是分支点竞争。这和 BDO 的通量集中逻辑一致:要集中碳流到目标产物,必须减少竞争支的消耗。但特殊之处在于:苏氨酸和甲硫氨酸是必需氨基酸,不能完全敲除(除非补料)。所以'减弱'(attenuation)优于'敲除'(KO)。
trigger.source_location: EcoCyc: aspartate pathway branch point; 教科书级代谢工程原则

evidence.description: 1) aspartate-semialdehyde 的分支结构是已知代谢网络事实(硬)。2) hom 和 thrB 的酶功能已在 EcoCyc 中策展(硬)。3) 敲除 hom 导致苏氨酸/甲硫氨酸营养缺陷——已知必需性(硬:可用 COBRApy 基因必需性反查验证)。
evidence.source_location: EcoCyc: HOM-MONOMER, THRB-MONOMER; COBRApy: hom/thrB essentiality check on glucose minimal medium

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 分支点结构和基因必需性是已确证的事实。减弱的效果方向(减少竞争→增加赖氨酸前体)是化学计量推理(硬),但具体减弱到什么程度需要实验优化。

alternatives.rejected_reason: 苏氨酸和甲硫氨酸是必需氨基酸,完全敲除产生营养缺陷型——除非培养基补料,否则致死。补料增加了成本和过程复杂度。

alternatives.approach: 只在培养基中补苏氨酸+甲硫氨酸并敲 hom
alternatives.rejected_reason: 补料是可行的替代方案,但增加了培养基成本和过程控制复杂度;减弱比敲除+补料更优雅
aspartate-semialdehyde 仍然被 hom 大量消耗——赖氨酸得率受限于碳流分配而非入口通量

decision_chain.implementation_detail: 用 CRISPRi 或启动子替换减弱(而非敲除)hom 和 thrB 的表达水平,减少竞争支的碳流消耗但保留足够通量维持苏氨酸/甲硫氨酸的基础供应

result.before: aspartate-semialdehyde 被竞争支大量消耗
result.after: 更多 aspartate-semialdehyde 碳流进入 DAP/赖氨酸分支,得率提升

decision_chain.rule: 分支点竞争:当目标产物和必需营养物共享前体时,减弱(KO 或 CRISPRi)竞争支而非完全敲除。先用 COBRApy 基因必需性反查确认靶标是否必需——必需基因改 CRISPi/弱化启动子,非必需基因可直接 KO。减弱程度需要实验优化:太弱→营养缺陷,太强→竞争仍未解除。

engineering_actions.gene_or_pathway: lysC (feedback-resistant allele targeting the lysine-binding regulatory domain); the specific substitution is not verified against a primary source in this knowledge base
engineering_actions.source: general, well-established metabolic-engineering pattern (feedback-resistant aspartokinase for aspartate-pathway deregulation); not a specific verified experimental result from a single cited paper in this knowledge base
engineering_actions.rationale: replacing wild-type lysC with a feedback-resistant (lysC-fbr) allele removes lysine-mediated allosteric inhibition of the pathway's entry step, raising the flux ceiling into the whole aspartate pathway
engineering_actions.expected_effect: increased flux into the aspartate pathway independent of intracellular lysine concentration
engineering_actions.risk: uncontrolled aspartate-pathway flux can draw down amino acid precursor pools needed elsewhere and increase metabolic burden; accumulation of pathway intermediates can itself become growth-inhibitory
validation: measure aspartokinase activity in vitro with and without added lysine to confirm feedback resistance
compare intracellular aspartate-semialdehyde pool size before and after the mutation

engineering_actions.gene_or_pathway: hom / thrB (homoserine dehydrogenase / homoserine kinase); attenuation rather than full knockout, since threonine and methionine remain required for growth unless supplemented
engineering_actions.source: general, well-established metabolic-engineering pattern (competing-branch attenuation to redirect a shared precursor pool); not a specific verified experimental result from a single cited paper in this knowledge base
engineering_actions.rationale: hom and thrB consume the same aspartate-semialdehyde precursor pool the lysine (DAP) branch depends on; reducing (not eliminating) flux through this branch leaves more precursor available for lysine biosynthesis
engineering_actions.expected_effect: more aspartate-semialdehyde flux available to the DAP/lysine branch
engineering_actions.risk: over-attenuation can create a threonine/methionine auxotrophy or growth defect, since both are essential amino acids the cell cannot omit entirely; this is not a safe unconditional knockout and needs dose-controlled attenuation or media supplementation
validation: confirm the strain is not auxotrophic for threonine/methionine under the intended cultivation medium, or supplement accordingly
compare growth rate and biomass yield to the unmodified control strain

_engineering_actions_note: Kept verbatim from DDR schema v1 (not part of the teacher's v2 spec) because workflows/synbio_v1/modules/engineering.py - a separate, older demo pipeline distinct from harness/paper_extraction - still reads this exact key/shape. decision_chain above is the canonical v2 source; this array is a compat projection of the same underlying facts, not independently curated content.

engineering_problem.problem_statement: L-lysine titer is limited by feedback inhibition of aspartate-pathway enzymes by lysine and by flux diversion into the competing threonine/methionine branch, not solely by the capacity of the lysine-specific (DAP) branch enzymes.
trigger_conditions: target product depends on the aspartate-derived amino acid family pathway
aspartokinase and/or dihydrodipicolinate synthase activity is feedback-inhibited by pathway end products
a substantial fraction of aspartate-semialdehyde flux is consumed by the competing threonine/methionine branch

observations: wild-type aspartokinase III (lysC) activity is allosterically inhibited by lysine, capping flux into the aspartate pathway once intracellular lysine rises
dihydrodipicolinate synthase (dapA), the first committed step of the lysine-specific (DAP) branch, is itself subject to feedback inhibition by lysine
aspartate-semialdehyde is a shared branch-point precursor consumed by both the DAP (lysine) branch and the homoserine (threonine/methionine) branch
bottlenecks: feedback inhibition of aspartokinase (lysC) by lysine limits total flux into the aspartate pathway
competing consumption of aspartate-semialdehyde by the threonine/methionine branch (hom, thrB) diverts flux away from lysine
feedback inhibition of dihydrodipicolinate synthase (dapA) limits flux specifically within the lysine-specific DAP branch
biological_diagnosis.mechanistic_explanation: E. coli's aspartate pathway is a branch-point network feeding lysine, threonine, methionine, and isoleucine biosynthesis from a shared precursor pool. Both the entry enzyme (aspartokinase) and the first lysine-branch-committed enzyme (dapA) are subject to allosteric feedback inhibition by lysine. Independently, the shared aspartate-semialdehyde precursor is also drawn off by the competing homoserine/threonine/methionine branch.

engineering_hypothesis.hypothesis: Relieving feedback inhibition of the aspartate-pathway entry point (a feedback-resistant lysC allele) together with attenuating - not eliminating - the competing threonine/methionine branch (hom/thrB) redirects aspartate-semialdehyde flux toward the lysine-specific DAP branch more effectively than terminal-enzyme overexpression alone.
engineering_hypothesis.expected_effect: increased flux through the DAP branch and higher L-lysine titer

extraction_meta.calibration_notes: v1→v2 升级。此 DDR 为教科书级知识综合,非单篇论文的决策链——已在 reason_nature 中如实标注为'机理推断'而非伪装为论文实测。decision_chain 可扩展到包括 dapA 反馈抗性(第三步),当前 2 步覆盖核心逻辑。
extraction_meta.review_notes: 作为 synthesis 类型的 DDR,没有单篇论文可以追溯——这是合理的。但建议在 rule 中引用实际论文先例(如色氨酸的 TrpE-fbr 模式)。
